profile.headline: DevSecOps Engineer, Python coder, author, encourager.
profile.summary:
I'm a DevSecOps Engineer with 40+ years in infrastructure and 30+ years teaching technical skills. I'm currently learning data engineering and agentic AI.

As an introvert with a speech impediment who became a certified instructor (martial arts, scuba assistant-instructor, NRA, Red Cross Instructor-Trainer), I learned that obstacles don't define limits. I focus on comprehensive documentation, practical demonstrations, and helping others overcome their own challenges.

Certifications: 
Platform Engineering Certified Practitioner (2026) | AWS Cloud Practitioner (2025) | Python PCEP (2022) | Security+ (2009-2028) | Linux+ (2011) | RHCE (2003) 

I'm learning to integrate AI with data applications in my 60's because continuous learning has no age limit. I believe in learning in public and teaching as I learn - sharing both successes and mistakes so others can benefit.

Read my journey: https://reuel.net/career/
See if my blog helps you: https://reuel.net/blog/
Find my projects: https://github.com/LeamHall

positions.title: Open Source Software Engineer
positions.description: Author of Python, Ansible, Go, and mentoring open source projects. Contributor to the Python, Perl, and Ruby languages. Wrote shell code for Red Hat STIG compliance.
positions.insights: Test Driven Development, Perl and +22 skills

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Added features and wrote bug-fixes for a third-party Python/Django/PostgreSQL cybersecurity tool with significant in-house modifications. Improved API functionality and optimized failover/failback processes. Wrote "New Member", Docker Compose configs, and Linux verification SOPs. Integrated code formatting, static analysis, and Make into the Gitlab CI/CD dev environment pre-commit process. Turned customer requests into requirements and designs.
positions.insights: Test Driven Development, Linux and +21 skills

positions.title: DevSecOps Engineer
positions.description: SME for Python, Ansible, Linux, Agile, TDD, Shell, and Git. Focused on toil reduction, automation engineering, process optimization, and mentoring. Wrote Python tool to pull logs from a vendor proprietary appliance and reformatting for Splunk. Analyzed use cases to provide live demos and team SOPs. Supported OpenShift architecture and AWS S3 cloud storage projects.
positions.insights: Test Driven Development, Linux and +22 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Wrote STIG based Linux/Unix and application cybersecurity scanning tool for the DoD HPCMP. Developed architecture, design, testing, and coding documents for 200K SLOC of organically developed Perl. Automated the QA cycle for an 8x time reduction while growing the test suite from 60 to 1,203 test files. Introduced TDD, code review, shorter sprints, and Git branching. Resolved issues with undocumented third-party API changes.
positions.insights: Test Driven Development, Linux and +23 skills

positions.title: Lead Engineer, Department of Defense
positions.description: Automated Linux build, patching, and verification processes. Analyzed high level designs, STIG/HW/SW requirements, and system architectures to turn a multi-week build process into automated tasks. Collated cybersecurity requirements into actionable plans that significantly reduced staff tasking. Provided ConOps documentation for remote secure site customers. Trained staff, gave briefings, and wrote technical plans for business development efforts.
positions.insights: Test Driven Development, Linux and +23 skills

positions.title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer, Department of Defense
positions.description: Led team that reviewed system architecture, ConOps, and use cases to complete a stalled ICS project in one week. Trained staff on coding languages, process automation, and Git. Worked with security team to quickly classify and programmatically resolve 95% of findings in one maintenance cycle to pass CCRI, RMF, and DoD IG inspections.
positions.insights: Test Driven Development, Linux and +23 skills
